title: India vs Pak Hockey WC: Knockout dream, survival at stake in blockbuster clash
content: India and Pakistan face off in a vital Hockey World Cup match on Wednesday. India need at least a draw to advance, while Pakistan must win. England have already secured a place in the next round after winning both their matches. The historic Wagener Stadium in Amstelveen will host this high-pressure contest. This match revives one of hockey's most storied rivalries with significant implications.

title: Apple shareholder since IPO in 1980 buys Ferrari’s first EV, designed by Jony Ive
content: Florida billionaire Herbert Wertheim purchased the first production Ferrari Luce for forty million dollars. This groundbreaking electric vehicle was designed with input from former Apple design chief Jony Ive.  The unique car, known as Chassis Zero, fetched an astonishing price at auction.  Wertheim, a long-time Apple shareholder, acquired the vehicle at an RM Sotheby's event.  The entire sale proceeds will benefit the Ferrari Foundation.

title: BJP puts Vinod Tawde, who played role in Bihar win, in charge of UP
content: The BJP has designated Vinod Tawde as its new state in-charge for Uttar Pradesh, while Satish Poonia takes the helm in Punjab. Additionally, Tarun Chugh has been entrusted with managing Gujarat's party affairs. These strategic appointments are pivotal as the BJP gears up for the imminent state elections, ensuring that influential leaders are aligned for key electoral battles.

title: Goa moves SC, seeks life imprisonment for Tejpal for sex assault
content: In a significant move, the Goa government has approached the Supreme Court, requesting a harsher sentence for Tarun Tejpal in a sexual assault case. The state argues that his current penalty is insufficient given the severity of the crime. They emphasize that Tejpal exploited his position of power, suggesting that time should not lessen the consequences for such an offense.

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40B in medical debt; how mechanics work
content: MacKenzie Scott's donations have enabled medical debt abolition across America. Her approach allows acquiring and erasing patient debt at steep discounts. This model has inspired other billionaires to contribute millions to similar initiatives. While philanthropic efforts provide immediate relief, policy reform remains stalled. Lasting change may require systemic reforms addressing the root causes of medical debt.

title: Pune boy, 11, dies on pothole-ridden road; MLA says 'accidents happen'
content: A young boy died on Pune's pothole-filled roads, leading to opposition criticism. Local MLA Shankar Mandekar stated accidents happen when roads exist, drawing anger. Residents complained about unaddressed road repair issues despite repeated pleas. Opposition leaders questioned government inaction and accountability for the tragic incident. They highlighted a lack of progress on promised infrastructure improvements.

title: New Zealand released 40 sparrows for pests, then paid bounties to kill them
content: New Zealand introduced house sparrows in 1867 hoping they would help farmers control crop-eating insects. The birds multiplied quickly and soon became a problem, feeding on grains and fruit and damaging wheat, barley and maize crops. Their rapid rise led to organised efforts to control them, including poisoned grain, shooting and bounties for eggs and heads. The story was part of a wider push to introduce European birds for farming and sentimental reasons.

title: US reservoir plan displaced 600 families; abandoned land became national park
content: The ambitious dam project planned for the Delaware River faced substantial backlash, resulting in its cancellation. This pivotal decision ultimately fostered the establishment of the Delaware Water Gap National Recreation Area, a refuge for the river's unspoiled segments. Factors such as environmental concerns and increasing financial burdens were significant in the cancellation, signaling a major milestone in US conservation efforts and land protection strategies.

title: Solar-powered backpacks to save endangered monarch butterflies in California
content: Scientists are using tiny solar-powered devices to track endangered monarch butterflies. Researchers are studying how these butterflies use their overwintering habitats and nectar sources. The migratory monarch butterfly was listed as Endangered on the IUCN Red List in 2022. This technology helps collect movement data and understand habitat use in California. Citizen scientists can also contribute observations through the Project Monarch app.

title: Barcelona sign Rodri from Man City: Spain captain joins star-studded squad
content: Barcelona has officially announced the signing of Spain captain Rodri from Manchester City. The accomplished midfielder has signed a contract keeping him at the club until 2030. Rodri arrives after playing a central role in Spain's World Cup triumph and winning the Ballon d'Or. This move strengthens Barcelona's squad for their third consecutive La Liga title push. Real Madrid had also reportedly shown interest in the talented Spanish midfielder.

title: In 1989, Apple buried about 2,700 Lisa computers in a landfill; here's why
content: In 1989, Apple buried about 2,700 unsold Lisa computers at a landfill in Logan, Utah, ending the story of one of its biggest early failures. Launched in 1983 with a graphical interface and mouse, the Lisa was ahead of its time but struggled because of its nearly $10,000 price and hardware problems. A computer reseller later tried to upgrade and sell thousands of the machines, but the effort ultimately failed. Today, surviving Lisa computers are valuable pieces of Apple history.

title: Ganguly recalls father feeding him before school and a parenting lesson to learn
content: Reflecting on his childhood, Sourav Ganguly shared the touching tradition of his father serving him breakfast daily before school, illustrating the strong bond it created during his early life. This underscores a valuable lesson for modern parents: establishing small, meaningful rituals can enrich family connections and turn everyday occurrences into lasting memories that children will treasure.

title: Ex-AAP minister Satyendar Jain arrested in Delhi Jal Board corruption case

title: What Trump’s latest safeguard tariff move on quartz surface products means for India
